item.description:

item.description:

The article argues that investors in Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF (VTI) might believe they are diversified across 3,600 stocks, but due to market-cap weighting, the fund is heavily concentrated in a few mega-cap tech companies, performing similarly to an S&P 500 fund (VOO) but with weaker returns.
